connector.name: Appstore Release MCP
connector.registryDescription: App Store release pilot - version bump, TestFlight upload, metadata, review submission
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package appstore-release-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rabdulsal account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
env.description: App Store Connect API key ID

env.name: APPLE_ISSUER_ID
env.description: App Store Connect API issuer ID

env.name: ASC_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to the .p8 App Store Connect API private key (alternative: APPLE_KEY_CONTENT with base64-encoded key)

env.name: APPLE_KEY_CONTENT
env.description: Base64-encoded .p8 private key content (alternative to ASC_KEY_PATH)

env.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
env.description: Apple Developer team ID (required for builds/uploads)

env.name: ASC_BUNDLE_ID
env.description: Bundle identifier of the app to manage, e.g. com.example.myapp

env.name: ASC_PROJECT_DIR
env.description: Xcode project root where fastlane runs (default: current working directory)

env.name: ASC_PLATFORM
env.description: App Store platform: IOS (default), MAC_OS, TV_OS, or VISION_OS

env.name: ASC_FASTLANE_LANE
env.description: Fastlane lane used for archive + upload (default: beta)

env.name: ASC_FASTLANE_PLATFORM
env.description: Fastlane platform prefix, e.g. mac or ios

env.name: ASC_UPLOAD_CMD
env.description: Full override of the upload command, e.g. 'bundle exec fastlane ios beta'
